originalArchitecture: One smoothly joined iron-and-glass roof over a four-by-four streamed district
Four central reflecting-pond quarters when the whole district is available
Two walkable levels; a continuous raised perimeter and crossing bridges
Dogleg stairs placed opposite the shared water quarter
Eight garden programmes: palms, ferns, rock terraces, flowers, tea, seed nursery, herbarium, water
adaptations: Original interior design rather than a copy of Kew plans or another game
Peaceful shared-garden stories, no NPCs required
Roof and upper/external glazing have real collision; water has basin bottoms and exit steps
Partial biome borders remain furnished conservatory annexes; mall/terrain reservations preserved
